The structure of PdAg₃ crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms (Pd₄Ag₁₂) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. The 12-vertex coordination polyhedra of Ag and Pd centers display corner-, edge-, and face-sharing relations, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
